renderPacket.identity: Real Masada in Israel's Judean Desert, viewed from an elevated oblique position that clearly shows the isolated flat-topped rock plateau with recognizable Herodian archaeological ruins on the summit and the pale blue Dead Sea stretching behind it; steep ochre desert escarpments and wadis frame the plateau. Broad horizontal 3:2 composition, Masada remains unmistakable in a mobile crop, with calmer open desert or sky toward one side for page copy. Soft early-morning desert light, restrained ochre, sand, stone and muted blue palette, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No fantasy fortress reconstruction, giant intact palace walls, dramatic poster sunset, oversized people, flags, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real Tel Aviv White City along Rothschild Boulevard at human eye level: 1930s International Style white and cream apartment buildings with ribbon windows, rounded balconies and pilotis behind a mature tree-lined median; a lived-in urban street without glass-skyscraper dominance. One continuous horizontal 3:2 view in restrained morning light, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No beach, poster crowds, fantasy architecture, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real Acre (Akko) Old City harbor on Israel's Mediterranean coast: pale limestone sea walls and dense historic stone buildings enclosing a small working harbor with a restrained number of fishing boats; fortified shoreline and old-city fabric remain dominant. One continuous horizontal 3:2 view, soft daylight, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No cruise ship or high-rise dominance, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real Bahá’í Terraces in Haifa viewed from an upper terrace looking down the strong central axis: symmetric garden terraces step toward the golden-domed Shrine of the Báb, with Haifa city, bay and port beyond. One continuous horizontal 3:2 view, clear restrained daylight, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No fantasy garden, oversized dome, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real view from Mount Arbel above the Sea of Galilee: pale limestone cliff and dry grass foreground, blue lake below, agricultural fields and rolling hills around the basin. One continuous horizontal 3:2 landscape, natural daylight, restrained palette, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No alpine scenery, tropical vegetation, oversized lake, city skyline, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Inside a real bell-shaped man-carved chalk cave at Beit Guvrin–Maresha: cream limestone walls broaden toward the floor and narrow to a circular roof opening, with natural daylight falling into the quiet excavated chamber. One continuous horizontal 3:2 interior, restrained stone palette, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No stalactites, fantasy cathedral scale, colored lighting, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real Makhtesh Ramon viewed from the north rim near Mitzpe Ramon: a vast elongated erosional depression with layered ochre, brown and gray strata, dry wadis and ridges extending across the Negev. It must read as an erosion cirque/makhtesh, not a volcanic crater. One continuous horizontal 3:2 landscape, restrained desert light, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No giant dune field, fantasy spires, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real Solomon’s Pillars in Timna Valley: tall naturally eroded red sandstone pillars attached to the cliff face, rising from the open Arava desert with layered desert mountains beyond. Geological forms, not classical built columns. One continuous horizontal 3:2 view, warm restrained daylight, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No lush oasis, fantasy monumentality, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real Caesarea Maritima Roman theatre on Israel's Mediterranean coast: semicircular stone seating and stage area with the sea visibly close behind and low coastal archaeological remains nearby. One continuous horizontal 3:2 view, clear coastal daylight, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No Colosseum-style arena, giant intact ancient city, resort dominance, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.
